prompt: Write acceptance criteria. Requirement: Managers approve expense reports. A report above the approval limit goes to the finance team. A report that is not approved in time is escalated to the next manager. A rejected report returns to the submitter with a reason. Receipts are required for expenses above the receipt threshold. Approved reports are paid in the next payment run.
output:
## Acceptance criteria: expense reports

Requirement: Managers approve expense reports, which go to the finance team above the approval limit, are escalated to the next manager when not approved in time, return to the submitter with a reason when rejected, need receipts for expenses above the receipt threshold and are paid in the next payment run once approved.

### Main path
AC-1. Given an approved expense report, when the next payment run takes place, then the report is paid. _Approved reports are paid in the next payment run._

### Validation and errors
AC-2. Given a submitted expense report, when the report is rejected, then the report returns to the submitter. _A rejected report returns to the submitter_
AC-3. Given a rejected expense report that has returned to the submitter, when the submitter views it, then it shows a reason. _with a reason_

### Permissions and roles
AC-4. Given a submitted expense report, when a manager approves it, then the report is approved. _Managers approve expense reports._
AC-5. Given an expense report above the approval limit, when the report is submitted, then the report goes to the finance team. _A report above the approval limit goes to the finance team._
AC-6. Given an expense report that is not approved in time, when the time for approval has passed, then the report is escalated to the next manager. _A report that is not approved in time is escalated to the next manager._

### Limits
AC-7. Given an expense above the receipt threshold, when its expense report is submitted, then a receipt is required for that expense. _Receipts are required for expenses above the receipt threshold._

### Open questions
- [blocking] Permissions and roles: Who may reject an expense report? Blocks: AC-2
- [blocking] Permissions and roles: What amount is the approval limit? Blocks: AC-5
- [blocking] Permissions and roles: How much time does a manager have to approve a report before it is escalated? Blocks: AC-6
- [blocking] Permissions and roles: Who is the next manager for an escalated report? Blocks: AC-6
- [blocking] Limits: What amount is the receipt threshold? Blocks: AC-7
- [blocking] Limits: What happens when an expense above the receipt threshold has no receipt? Blocks: AC-7
- [minor] Main path: When does the next payment run take place? Permissions and roles: Which manager approves a given report?
- [minor] Limits: Does a report exactly at the approval limit go to the finance team? Limits: Does an expense exactly at the receipt threshold need a receipt?
- [minor] Validation and errors: Can a report be rejected without a reason? Validation and errors: What can the submitter do with a returned report?

### Out of scope
None stated.
